standard-dialogue-raking-the-patches-bef.npc: Hey - what are you doing with that patch, peasant?!? One demands that you speak to one's self immediately!!

standard-dialogue-raking-the-patches-bef.text: [Roughly translated, this means that Queen Ellamaria would like a word.]

standard-dialogue-attempting-to-climb-th.npc: I shall not allow you to climb my trellis, peasant. Only providing your assistance to my project might cause me to reconsider.

standard-dialogue-after-garden-of-tranqu.player: Can I use this garden for my own farming?

standard-dialogue-after-garden-of-tranqu.npc: What, you want to dig up the plants that took one so long to grow? Don't be ridiculous, you silly little fool.

standard-dialogue-after-garden-of-tranqu.player: All right then, sorry I asked.

standard-dialogue-after-garden-of-tranqu.npc: Impertinent peasant! Oh, if you promise to leave one alone then feel free to pick fruit from the White Tree. One is told that they are a great natural energy restorative.

Botherations, will you never leave one alone?!? One has no further need for you, so please do one a favour and remove your ungainly presence from my husband's garden before one has you arrested for loitering!
